summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 16, 2026, reporting a material change dated September 14, 2026. The company obtained a final receipt for a short form base shelf prospectus and its U.S. Form F-10 registration statement became effective, permitting up to US$200 million of securities offerings over 25 months. Simultaneously, it filed a qualifying prospectus supplement covering 5,828,342 special warrants converting into voting shares and warrants, plus a resale prospectus supplement for selling shareholders. This is a routine shelf and warrant qualification, not a special situation.
